_comment: Copy this file to appsettings.json and fill in your own values. Never commit real secrets.
_seatComment: Module 9. SeatMatch: MachineName | Ip | Either. Labs:AutoRegister enrols every PC a student logs in from (demo only - it defeats seat enforcement; the dotnet-run launch profiles turn it on). Exams:RequireDesktopClientForStart refuses exam starts from web-portal tokens.
_submissionComment: Module 6. Submission:TimeoutSweepSeconds — how often the server times out sessions still in progress past their deadline (exam end + per-student extra minutes + 2 min grace); they are graded and get a receipt. 0 disables the sweeper.
_monitoringComment: Module 5. Monitoring:DisconnectAfterSeconds — a running session with no heartbeat for this long is flagged Disconnected (checked every DisconnectSweepSeconds; 0 disables the watchdog). MaxScreenshotsPerMinute caps captures per session. Storage:EvidencePath — folder for screen/webcam captures (relative = under the API's content root; keep it out of any web root); RetentionDays — captures older than this are deleted every CleanupIntervalSeconds (0 disables the job).
_gradingComment: Module 11. Grading:Runner = Auto (Docker sandbox when Docker and the image are available, else local MinGW g++ labelled not isolated, else no compilation) | Docker | Local | None. Pre-pull the image: docker pull gcc:13. Local:GppPath overrides g++ discovery (PATH, then C:/MinGW/bin/g++.exe). Limits apply per test case (a case may set its own time limit). Llm is OFF by default; enabling it needs the API key in the environment variable named by ApiKeyEnv (default GROQ_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY) - never put a key in this file. Only question, model answer, rubric and answer text are sent, never names or ids.
_bootstrapComment: Module 7. Only a SuperAdmin can create/manage Admin accounts. A database with no SuperAdmin gets one at startup when Bootstrap__SuperAdminEmail is set (environment variable; an existing account with that email is promoted, otherwise it is created with Bootstrap__SuperAdminPassword). Set them for one start only, never commit a password.
